multi_timeframe_logic.rule: Direction (long/short) is set by trend_frames. Refine the level on structure_frames. Time the entry on entry_timing_frames. If 1D and 4H disagree, treat as NEUTRAL / stand aside. Lower frames (1m/5m) are noise for bias — use them ONLY for entry timing, never to flip the trend.

bias_criteria.bullish: Price above 50D EMA, RSI on daily between 45 and 70, higher highs and higher lows on 4H
bias_criteria.bearish: Price below 50D EMA, RSI on daily below 45, lower highs and lower lows on 4H
bias_criteria.neutral: Price chopping around 50D EMA, RSI between 40 and 60, no clear structure

indicators_i_care_about: Volume Profile / Fixed Range (POC, VAH, VAL)

liquidation_and_orderbook.what_i_want: Read the liquidation heatmap / order-book heatmap to help decide long vs short.
liquidation_and_orderbook.trdr_io_status: trdr.io has NO public developer API (api subdomain does not exist, site is bot-blocked 403, docs mention no API/key/webhook). It cannot be queried programmatically.
liquidation_and_orderbook.the_workaround: TRDR is 'powered by TradingView' — its Liquidations and 'Order Book Top Levels' heatmap are TradingView indicators. Add them to the chart on TradingView Desktop, then the MCP reads their plotted output.
liquidation_and_orderbook.free_alternative_script: tradingview-mcp-setup/liquidation_heatmap.pine — an estimated liquidation-ZONES heatmap (swing-based, volume-weighted, leverage tiers 10/25/50/100x). Draws semi-transparent boxes that stack/darken where zones overlap. Load it on the chart; the MCP reads it via data_get_pine_boxes (zones), data_get_pine_labels, data_get_pine_tables. study_filter="Liquidation". NOTE: estimate only, not real exchange liquidation data.
how_mcp_reads_it: data_get_pine_lines with study_filter for the liquidation indicator -> horizontal liquidation price levels
data_get_study_values -> Volume Profile POC / VAH / VAL
liquidation_and_orderbook.decision_use: Big liquidation cluster ABOVE price = magnet/likely sweep up (favors short-squeeze / fade or long into it). Big cluster BELOW price = downside liquidity (favors long-squeeze / stop-run lower). Confirm direction with multi_timeframe_logic before committing.

leverage_rules.comment: Stop loss is ALWAYS structure-based and must sit well inside the liquidation buffer. At 3x, liquidation is ~33% away, so a swing stop should be a fraction of that.

stop_loss_for_3x.long: Place stop just BELOW the most recent confirmed 4H swing low, or below the 50 EMA — whichever protects structure. Hard cap: adverse move <= 10% from entry.
stop_loss_for_3x.short: Place stop just ABOVE the most recent confirmed 4H swing high, or above the 50 EMA — whichever protects structure. Hard cap: adverse move <= 10% from entry.
stop_loss_for_3x.position_sizing: Size the position so the loss at the stop is <= 1% of portfolio (see risk_rules.max_risk_per_trade). Leverage does NOT change risk-per-trade; it only changes margin used.

trade_plan_formulas.cost_price: entry = actual fill price reported by the chart/quote (quote_get last price)

liquidation_price.note: Approximate, isolated margin, fees/funding ignored. L = leverage, M = maintenance_margin_rate.

long.tp2: next major 4H/1D resistance / prior swing high

short.tp2: next major 4H/1D support / prior swing low

analysis_workflow_per_symbol: 1. chart_set_symbol to the target coin, then chart_get_state to read symbol + visible indicators.

2. Walk timeframes_to_check (1m,5m,15m,30m,1H,4H,1D) using timeframe_codes_for_mcp. Read 50/200 EMA, RSI(14), MACD, Volume, Ichimoku (price vs cloud, TK cross), Volume Profile (POC/VAH/VAL), Stoch RSI via data_get_study_values.
2b. Read liquidation/order-book levels per liquidation_and_orderbook.how_mcp_reads_it (if those indicators are on the chart).
3. Decide bias with multi_timeframe_logic (1D+4H set direction) and bias_criteria -> LONG / SHORT / STAND ASIDE. Use liquidation clusters + POC as confluence, lower frames only for entry timing.
7. Compute R, then TP1/TP2/TP3 per trade_plan_formulas.targets (TP1 must be >= 2R).
8. Reject the setup if it violates risk_rules (CPI/FOMC/weekend) or if RR < 2.
9. Report: coin, direction (long/short), leverage (3x), entry/cost, stop, liquidation, TP1/TP2/TP3.
